The Blazor Web App is ready. Here's what was built:

**Project structure:**
```
RecipeCommunity/
├── Models/           Recipe.cs, SubmitRecipeModel.cs
├── Services/         RecipeService.cs (singleton, in-memory data + 8 seed recipes)
├── Components/
│   ├── Pages/
│   │   ├── Home.razor          — Category grid homepage (static SSR)
│   │   ├── Category.razor      — Browse recipes by category (static SSR)
│   │   ├── RecipeDetail.razor  — Recipe view + star rating
│   │   └── SubmitRecipe.razor  — Submit form (InteractiveServer)
│   └── Shared/
│       └── StarRating.razor    — Click-to-rate 1–5 stars (InteractiveServer)
```

**Key design decisions:**
- **Per-component interactivity** — only `StarRating` and `SubmitRecipe` use `@rendermode InteractiveServer`; all other pages are static SSR
- Homepage, category browsing, and recipe detail content render as static HTML for fast loads
- Form uses `EditForm` with `DataAnnotationsValidator` for validation
- `RecipeService` is registered as a singleton with 8 seed recipes across 6 categories

Run with `dotnet run --project RecipeCommunity`.
